title: Stone Room Note on the Holdback Against Placing a Centre Stone Elsewhere
content:
# Stone Room Note on the Holdback Against Placing a Centre Stone Elsewhere

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request, what is held back against placing the centre stone elsewhere turns on the weight of the centre stone the commission is built around and on whether any stage of production stands recorded on the commission.

## The holdbacks

1. Where the centre stone the commission is built around weighs at or above the studio's large stone weight, which is 3.00 carats, and no stage of production stands recorded on the commission, 6 per cent of the remainder is held back against placing the stone elsewhere.
2. Where the centre stone weighs at or above the smallest weight the programme will build around and below 3.00 carats, and no stage of production stands recorded, 2.5 per cent of the remainder is held back.
3. Otherwise nothing is held back against placing the centre stone elsewhere.

The centre stone's weight stands on the commission record, in carats to two decimal places. A stage of production stands recorded where at least one production stage entry has been booked to the commission; where one has, nothing is held back whatever the stone weighs.

## The smallest weight each programme builds around

| Programme | Smallest centre stone weight the programme builds around (carats) |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 0.25 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 0.30 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 0.50 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 1.00 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 0.25 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 2.00 |

## Weight bands (hypothetical)

On a remainder of USD 8000.00, with no stage of production recorded, under Belrose Bespoke Design, whose smallest centre stone weight is 0.50 carats:

| Centre stone weight | Held back |
|---|---|
| 3.00 carats | 6 per cent, that is USD 480.00 |
| 2.99 carats | 2.5 per cent, that is USD 200.00 |
| 0.50 carats | 2.5 per cent, that is USD 200.00 |
| 0.49 carats | Nothing is held back against placing the centre stone elsewhere |
